startup_file.what: Founded in 2018 by aerospace engineers Gurushankara KC, Abhinav Alva and Chetan Kumar. Develops small gas turbine engines (20 kgf to 400 kgf thrust) for aerial platforms and energy systems, with the design, assembly and testing pipeline and its engine control unit built in-house. Expanding into hydrogen-based technology and distributed power generation, including a 60 kW turbogenerator with a hydrogen flexi-fuel combustor developed with IISc.
how: Sells engines to OEMs: the company says it already has orders from Indian and global OEMs but did not disclose names or values.

country.pr: Settlement permit after 27 months on a Blue Card with A1 German, or 21 months with B1 German.

country.con: Political risk: the AfD won 44% in Saxony-Anhalt (early September 2026) and polled around 37% ahead of the 20 September votes in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern and Berlin.
